nodes.text: HMPV accounts for approximately 3% of respiratory pathogens (@ICMRDELHI) detected in laboratory networks testing for Influenza-like Illness (ILI) and Severe Acute Respiratory Infections (SARI). Other circulating viruses include Influenza A & B, SARS-CoV-2, and RSV.

nodes.author: Genopanda
nodes.text: As with any respiratory infection, it’s essential to take basic precautions: wear a mask, wash hands frequently, avoid crowded places, and consult a healthcare professional if symptoms worsen.
